description: Convert Anticapture dashboard to a fully static IPFS-hostable frontend for eth.limo

userStories.title: Configure Next.js for static export
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project to produce a static HTML/JS/CSS build that can be deployed to IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: next.config.mjs has output: 'export' set
All next/image usages replaced with or next/image with unoptimized: true
All API routes removed (app/api/ directory deleted or emptied)
Server-side redirects converted to client-side or removed
next build produces a static out/ directory with all pages
No getServerSideProps or server-only imports remain
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This is the foundation — everything else depends on the build working. next/image is used across many components, may need a find-and-replace pass.

userStories.title: Implement Gateful REST data fetching layer
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean data layer that fetches from the Gateful REST API so the app works without the GraphQL API Gateway.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shared/data/ directory with typed API client for Gateful REST endpoints

Implement typed fetch functions for: /{daoId}/proposals, /{daoId}/token, /{daoId}/treasury/liquid, /{daoId}/feed/events, /{daoId}/accounts/{address}/delegations, /{daoId}/token/historical-data, and compare endpoints
Replace Apollo Client with TanStack Query (already a dependency) + native fetch for REST calls
Remove @anticapture/graphql-client workspace dependency from dashboard
Create React hooks (useProposals, useToken, useTreasury, useFeedEvents, useDelegations, etc.) wrapping the REST client with TanStack Query
Config allows setting Gateful API base URL at build time via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var
All data types are defined matching actual Gateful API response shapes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Gateful is a REST API at https://gateful.up.railway.app with CORS enabled. Supported DAOs: ens, uni, comp, nouns, gtc, obol, scr (NOT op). Apollo Client and graphql-client package should be fully removed.

userStories.title: Remove server-side dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to strip all server-only code so the static export build succeeds.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/contact/ route removed, contact page uses mailto: link
app/api/figma/ route removed
resend package removed from production dependencies
Server-only env vars no longer referenced at runtime
next.config.mjs redirects replaced with client-side redirect component or removed
serverExternalPackages config removed from next.config.mjs
Build completes with output: 'export' without errors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Must come after US-001 (static export config). Server env vars: RESEND_API_KEY, FIGMA_TOKEN, CONTACT_EMAIL, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, VERCEL_URL.

userStories.title: Static path generation for DAO pages
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access each DAO dashboard via a clean URL that works on IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: generateStaticParams implemented for [daoId] routes returning all 8 DAOs from dao-config
Each DAO main page and all sub-pages are pre-rendered at build time
out/ directory contains HTML files for every DAO route (e.g. out/ens/index.html)
Proposal detail pages use client-side catch-all route since proposalIds are dynamic
404 page renders for unknown DAOs
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: DAOs supported by Gateful: ENS, UNI, COMP, NOUNS, GTC, OBOL, SCR (NOT OP — returns 404). Sub-pages: attack-profitability, holders-and-delegates, resilience-stages, risk-analysis, token-distribution, governance. Proposal pages are dynamic — cannot pre-render all IDs.

userStories.title: Fix asset paths for IPFS compatibility
userStories.description: As a user accessing the site via IPFS gateway, I need all assets to load correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: next.config.mjs configured for IPFS-compatible relative asset paths
All static assets in public/ referenced with relative paths
No hardcoded absolute URLs to localhost or specific domains for assets
Google Fonts replaced with self-hosted Inter font in public/fonts/
Built out/ directory serves correctly via npx serve out
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: IPFS gateways serve content at varying path depths. Relative paths (./ or no leading /) are safest. next/font may not work with static export — test and replace if needed.

userStories.title: Client-side analytics replacement
userStories.description: As a developer, I need analytics to work without server-side code or be gracefully disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: PostHog uses client-side-only SDK or is removed
Umami uses client-side script tag or is removed
No analytics code causes build failures or runtime errors
Analytics can be enabled/disabled via build-time env var
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: PostHog and Umami are in shared/services/. Check if they already use client-only patterns or need conversion.

userStories.title: Contact and donation pages — static conversion
userStories.description: As a user, I want informational pages to work without server APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact page uses mailto: link instead of API route form submission
Donation page works fully client-side (wallet interaction already is)
FAQ, glossary, and terms pages render as static pages
All informational pages accessible and correct in static build
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Low risk story. Most of these pages are already mostly static. Contact form is the main change.

userStories.title: IPFS deployment script
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a one-command deployment script to build and pin to IPFS.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/deploy-ipfs.sh builds the project and pins out/ to IPFS
Script supports both local ipfs CLI and Pinata API
Script prints the CID and eth.limo URL for verification
README documents full deployment flow including ENS content hash update
.env.example updated with all required build-time env vars
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Use ipfs add -r --cid-version=1 for CIDv1 (base32) which is needed for ENS content hash. Pinata is backup for CI/CD.

userStories.title: Smoke test — full static build verification
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests verifying the static build works end-to-end.
acceptanceCriteria: Test script builds project with next build
Verifies out/ directory exists with expected structure
Serves out/ with local HTTP server and checks key pages return 200
Verifies no broken asset references in generated HTML
Runnable in CI via npm run test:smoke
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This is the final safety net. Should check: home page, at least 2 DAO pages, 404 page, asset files exist.

Documents: prerequisites, local dev, static build, IPFS deployment, ENS setup
Explains data provider abstraction and how to swap backends
Lists all build-time env vars with descriptions
Includes text-based architecture diagram
